Capabilities and product certification are separate. Unverified does not mean known to fail. Test browsers do not certify physical devices.

WebGPU is experimental in this product. XR currently requires classic WebGL. This page does not start XR sessions. Minimum hardware and full support require physical-device and workflow evidence.

Production requires trusted HTTPS. Browser code only reports secure context; IT must verify the certificate chain, SAN, expiry and trust store. A secure localhost is not an intranet HTTPS acceptance test.

Rolling certification targets the stable major at release and its predecessor. Only finite certified ranges in the table are commitments. Enterprise frozen versions require a separate record.

The full Appliance additionally requires OPFS, service health and WSS acceptance. Single-file demos follow the separate L2-2 scope. Browser extensions are not required; deployment services and XR system components are separate.
